parameters.query:
SELECT cp.online_provider_choice AS enabled, cp.industry, cp.staff_label, cp.timezone, cp.company_name,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', p.name, 'price', p.unit_price::float, 'durations', p.durations) ORDER BY lower(p.name))
            FROM products p WHERE p.is_active AND p.bookable_online), '[]'::json) AS services,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id', sm.id, 'name', sm.name) ORDER BY lower(sm.name))
            FROM staff_members sm JOIN users u ON u.id = sm.owner_user_id AND u.active WHERE sm.is_active AND sm.bookable_online), '[]'::json) AS providers
FROM company_profile cp WHERE cp.id = 1;

parameters.responseBody: ={{ (() => { const r = $input.first().json; const providers = r.providers || []; return { success: true, enabled: r.enabled === true && providers.length > 0, staff_label: r.staff_label || 'Therapist', timezone: r.timezone || '', company_name: r.company_name || '', industry: r.industry || null, services: r.services || [], providers }; })() }}

parameters.query:
WITH cfg AS (SELECT timezone, booking_hours, online_provider_choice, time_format FROM company_profile WHERE id = 1),
prov AS (
  SELECT sm.id FROM staff_members sm JOIN users u ON u.id = sm.owner_user_id AND u.active
  WHERE sm.is_active AND sm.bookable_online AND ($1 = 'any' OR sm.id::text = $1)
), busy AS (
  SELECT a.staff_id, a.due_at, COALESCE(a.end_at, a.due_at + interval '30 minutes') AS end_at
  FROM activities a
  WHERE a.staff_id IN (SELECT id FROM prov) AND a.is_completed = false AND a.outcome IS NULL
    AND a.due_at > now() - interval '1 day' AND a.due_at < now() + interval '75 days'
)
SELECT (SELECT row_to_json(cfg) FROM cfg) AS cfg,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(id) FROM prov), '[]'::json) AS providers,
  COALESCE((SELECT json_agg(row_to_json(busy)) FROM busy), '[]'::json) AS busy;
SELECT rate_limit_ok($1, $2, $3::int, interval '1 hour') AND ($4 = '' OR rate_limit_ok($1 || ':email', $4, $5::int, interval '1 hour')) AS ok;
